h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Varanasi

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Varanasi

c: Mornings on the Varanasi ghats begin before sunrise, with walkers, bathers and yoga groups along the river. That early-morning habit makes the city a good place for open gyms, in parks, campuses and colony grounds. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Varanasi for the BHU campus area, other colleges, schools, municipal parks, ashrams and residential colonies. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,230 km away.

Varanasi has very hot summers, a humid monsoon and cold, foggy winters, often all in strong measure. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for that range. We send the machines by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs them after you approve a layout drawing with every station and its clear space marked.

richText.heading: An open gym for a campus or colony ground

c: On a university campus, students and staff use the gym at different times, so mix strength and gentle machines. The

Winter fog leaves the machines wet in the morning, so wipe the handles before use. In summer, trees on the west side of the gym give evening shade. A paved base keeps dust down in the dry months. For children's equipment, see

items.q: Can ashrams and trusts in Varanasi set up an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. A few gentle machines such as walkers, twisters and pendulums suit residents and visitors of all ages. We plan the layout around your existing paths and buildings.

items.q: Do the machines rust in winter fog?
items.a: No. The frames are galvanised and many parts are roto-moulded, so moisture does not cause rust. Wipe the handles in the morning for comfortable use.

items.q: Do you deliver to eastern Uttar Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India and install through our team or a dealer in the northern region.
